{"design":"Audit 2026-11-04 (verified by orchestrator where marked):
- mimid's own codepoints: no mismatch with Rohan's gist (components, credential basic, wire formats, extension/proposal types, MIMI 0x0020-0x0023, room-policy 0x0024-0x0030).
- OpenMLS fork AND upstream main (verified): extension type 0x000a is still OpenMLS's legacy LastResort (empty struct, exact-length check), while ratchet-tree-options-02 §6.2 suggests 0x000A for ratchet_tree_source_domains. A peer's non-empty source_domains would fail to decode instead of passing through as unknown. Candidate: OpenMLS issue + rto WG note (value reuse).
- OpenMLS fork (verified) classifies component IDs 0x8a8a-0xeaea as GREASE; mls-extensions-11 §7.5 (verified) lists component GREASE only up to 0x7A7A and 0x8000-0xFFFF as private use. Upstream main's check looks the same (component.rs:64) — confirm, then OpenMLS issue. mimid avoids it (identity.rs:28-34).
- Gist gaps for Rohan: names 0x0021 franking_signature_key (protocol-07 §10.2 renamed franking_agent); credential-type collisions remain (0x0003 multi vs userinfo-vc, 0x0004 weak-multi vs addl-creds multi, 0x0005 weak-multi vs sd_cwt) despite "only conflict left".
- protocol-07 registers none of its signature labels (KeyMaterialRequestTBS, GroupInfoRequestTBS, GroupInfoResponseTBS, FrankingIntegrityTBS, PseudonymousCredentialTBS) or the HPKE label "GroupInfo and ratchet_tree encryption": wg item.
- Provisional values not documented in mimid: mls-extensions "(suggested)" extension types 0x0006-0x0008, proposal types 0x0008-0x000a; protocol-07 0x0020-0x0023 depend on a registry not yet created. Room-policy TBD values already documented (decision .3.27)."}
